![ADR-003 API-driven inbound provisioning architecture — any HR source (Workday, Oracle, or other) flows through a middleware layer that computes OrgPath into the Entra ID provisioning service; on-prem AD writeback via the provisioning agent is coexistence-only.](../images/canonical/UIAO-FIG-020-adr003-api-driven-inbound-provisioning.png){#fig-adr003-provisioning fig-alt="API-driven inbound provisioning architecture. A navy HR System box (Workday OR Oracle OR any source) flows via a teal arrow into a teal-bordered Middleware Layer box (Azure Functions / Logic Apps: schema normalization, OrgPath calculation, validation, provenance logging), then into an ice Entra ID Provisioning Service box (attribute mapping, JML workflows, group assignment, license assignment). A red dashed arrow drops to a red-tinted on-prem Provisioning Agent box doing AD writeback, tagged coexistence only. A callout notes OrgPath is computed in the middleware, independent of the HR source." width="100%"}
